notes.title: MINOR UPDATE: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
1. We have just fixed the issue of not being able to use a teleport function after restarting the game with autosave at the incinerator of the operation room because of the death regarding suffocation or gas explosion.
-> Now you can teleport when the game is restarted on the incinerator section.

Thank you for your feedback. We will be working hard to improve the experience and make it the best it can be.

notes.title: Patch 1.21
notes.notes:
UPDATE: Korean language support, bug fixes

2.     Some bugs found in the target range have been fixed.

notes.title: PATCH 1.2
notes.notes:
UPDATE : Control improvements for Oculus Touch users

1. Teleportation control change: It was originally possible to teleport using both controllers but from now on only the left controller will be used.
 
2. Grab action control change: Using the original control scheme for the Oculus Touch, there weren’t any issues regarding grabbing and holding items but when having to accurately throw object, it felt imprecise and awkward at times. 
We have therefore changed it so that grabbing is performed with the main triggers, which also makes throwing a more comfortable experience.

notes.title: Teleport Location Improvement - Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Teleport Location Improvement

1. We have fixed the issue of not teleporting to the desired location after moving in room scale.

2. We have just fixed the issue of being able to teleport to another room when the relevant puzzle has not yet been solved.

Thank you for your feedback. We will be working hard to improve the experience and make it the best it can be.
